name: ALPSTUGA air quality monitor
measure_description:
Measured on the USB port of the device (it does *not* come with a power adapter). The value is an average of a three day measurement session, where the device showed it has periods of higher and lower power usage. The voltage range is from a separate measurement session of a single day, which showed the same behavior. For more information see discussion #4750.

Measurement was taken with the display turned on.
